text: Minutes will be taken and placed in the shared folder by the end of the session. After lunch, the questionnaire will be filled in, with findings noting preferences for new features such as LCD and speech recognition that may not be feasible. Decisions set the remote as a non-receiver device, with Teletext outdated and the internet as the main focus, while considering a total touch screen or a partial touch-screen option to preserve traditional controls for elderly users. The remote should be restricted to television use and not be a multi-purpose remote control.
